newsitem.title: UK: Former BET head wins 3 mln stg compensation.
newsitem.headline: Former BET head wins 3 mln stg compensation.

text.p: John Clark, former chief executive of BET Plc, said on Wednesday he had been awarded damages of more than 3 million stg against Rentokil Initial Plc after alleging wrongful dismissal.

In a statement Clark said the damages awarded by the High Court took account of loss of future salary, bonuses and pension entitlement following Rentokil Plc's hostile takeover of BET earlier this year.
He added that the award was more than 2 million stg higher than the figure he had offered to settle for at the time of his dismissal.
Clark said the award represented "what the Court has held to be the strict entitlement under my contract and no more."
Representatives at Rentokil Initial were not immediately available for comment on the High Court's decision.
